notes.title: Zen Garden Demo Streaming
notes.notes:
We have very good news!
You can try the Zen Garden demo for the Steam Next Fest.

Zen Garden is a logic puzzle game, inspired by Japanese culture that mixes tradition and modernity.
Throughout the game the story will progress in which you will be guided by your sensei Fuurin.
A strange wind chime in the shape of a cat.
Who is he? Where are you?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/R4y7IXWM8CL6011LVs/giphy.gif[/img]

In this demo, you will try all the mechanics of the main game, and a short introduction to Zen Garden.
You will discover the world around you through puzzles deeply fueled by nature.

The Zen atmosphere, the contact with nature and the pixel art aesthetics will make you enter a state of relaxation from which you will not want to leave until you finish.

Manage to finish the demo and show us your level of Zen concentration.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Ci7DYhGzQArVVuXHHl/giphy.gif[/img]
